decision_process: Identify the primary audience and task.
Retrieve relevant industry and workflow knowledge.
Review existing website evidence if available.
Evaluate options against user needs and constraints.

evaluation_dimensions.question: Does the design help users complete the intended task?
Does the design support the confirmed business objective?
Can users understand the content and next steps?
Does the design communicate verified information without misleading claims?
Does the design support applicable accessibility requirements?
Can the proposed experience work with the approved systems?
Does the design preserve or intentionally change existing behavior?

decision_rules: Do not present aesthetic preference as evidence of usability.
Separate proposed design hypotheses from validated outcomes.
Prioritize safety and accessibility over decorative choices.
